scene yuminightschool1
: Welcome back.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool2
: Are we at...school? When did we get here?
lines.zh: : 我们是在……学校？我们什么时候到这儿的？

lines.en: : Somewhere in the time between your brain clockin’ out and then gettin’ called back in to work, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概是在你的大脑打卡下班、又被叫回来上班之间的那段时间吧。

lines.en: : Lasted a fuckin’ while this time. Guess it ain’t much compared to two months if that’s really what happened, though.
lines.zh: : 这次持续了挺久的。不过要是真有两个月那么长，这点时间也算不了什么。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool3
: And you stayed with me?
lines.zh: : 而你一直陪着我？

lines.en: : Looks that way. Ain’t like I had anything else going on after Chika kicked me out.
lines.zh: : 看起来是这样。反正 Chika 把我赶出来之后，我也没别的事可做。

lines.en: : But just because I didn’t leave you in some dried-up aqueduct with a decomposing chicken doesn’t mean I suddenly like you.
lines.zh: : 不过，我没把你丢在那条干涸的水渠边、跟一只腐烂的鸡作伴，不代表我就突然喜欢你了。

lines.en: : Really? Because that’s my go-to benchmark for deciding whether or not I’m close to someone.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？这可是我判断跟某人关系近不近的惯用标准。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool4
: Ha ha ha. Eat an entire bag of dicks.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。去吃一整袋鸡巴吧。

lines.en: : Why here?
lines.zh: : 为什么是这儿？

lines.en: : Fuck if I know. You kept sayin’ some shit about a box and, before I knew it, you were draggin’ me all the way across town and unlocking the gate.
lines.zh: : 鬼知道。你一直念叨什么箱子什么的，我还没反应过来，你就拖着我横穿了整个镇子，还把大门打开了。

lines.en: : Fine by me since there’s food here and shit. But I ain’t sure if it’s a good look for you to be wanderin’ around the halls with a delinquent after hours.
lines.zh: : 我无所谓，反正这儿有吃的什么的。不过你放学后带着一个不良少女在走廊晃，我可不确定这形象好不好。

lines.en: : You’re no longer a delinquent, though. Auto-pilot Yumi reformed herself during your two months of absence.
lines.zh: : 可你已经不是不良少女了。自动驾驶模式的 Yumi 在你消失的那两个月里把自己改造好了。

lines.en: : You say that as if you were there.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像你当时在场似的。

lines.en: : I kind of wish I was. Prefect Yumi is a sight I don’t think I’d ever be able to see otherwise.
lines.zh: : 我倒是有点希望自己在场。风纪委员 Yumi 的模样，我想除此之外我是没机会看到的。

lines.en: : No one said anything about bein’ a prefect. For all we know, I was still an asshole. Just a...more present asshole, I guess.
lines.zh: : 谁说我是风纪委员了。说不定我还是个混蛋。只是个……出勤率高点的混蛋吧。

lines.en: : Did I say anything else about a box?
lines.zh: : 关于那个箱子，我还说了别的吗？

lines.en: scene yuminightschool5
: You actually have an idea of what that means? Cause I kinda figured it was just mindless blackout shit.
lines.zh: : 你真知道那是什么意思？我还以为那就是断片时的胡话。

lines.en: : Yes and no. It’s hard to explain.
lines.zh: : 算是也不算是。很难解释。

lines.en: : Yeah, what else is fuckin’ new? This has quickly become the weirdest week ever and that’s in no small part to gettin’ dragged along in a day of the life of the world’s most open sex offender.
lines.zh: : 是啊，还有什么新鲜的。这周迅速变成了有史以来最诡异的一周，而其中很大一部分原因，就是被世界上最毫不掩饰的性犯罪者拽着过了一天。

lines.en: : This is probably the first full day we’ve spent together, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这大概是我们第一次完整相处一整天，是吧？

lines.en: : Depends on whether or not you count the last three hours as “you.”
lines.zh: : 就看过去这三个小时算不算「你」了。

lines.en: : Also, don’t go makin’ it sound like this was enjoyable for either one of us. Woulda had more fun stayin’ at home helpin’ Chika keep her sister alive.
lines.zh: : 还有，别把这说得像我们俩谁享受了一样。我留在家里帮 Chika 保住她妹妹的命还更有意思。

lines.en: : Go do that then. I can survive without a chaperone.
lines.zh: : 那你回去啊。没有监护人陪着我也死不了。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool6
: If I go...what’ll happen if you zone out again?
lines.zh: : 我要是走了……你再发呆断片怎么办？

lines.en: : Are you actually worried about me?
lines.zh: : 你真的在担心我？

lines.en: scene yuminightschool7

: N-No! Why the fuck would I ever worry about you?! I just meant I...I don’t really care about us bein’ alone anymore. I can hold my own if you decide to get all fucking...well...you know how you get.
lines.zh: : 才、才不是！我他妈为什么要担心你？！我只是说……我不太介意我们单独待着了。你要是又他妈……那个……你知道你发作起来什么样，我自己能应付。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool8
: Plus, we...kinda left off at a weird spot and...guess I’m still a little interested in whatever this whole memory shit is.
lines.zh: : 再说，我们……上次停在了一个挺奇怪的地方，而且……我对这整套记忆的破事还是有点兴趣的。

lines.en: : I’m just hangin’ around ‘cause I want answers. And if anybody’s got answers, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 我留下来就是想要答案。要说谁有答案，那也就是你了。

lines.en: : What made you change your mind? Because it seemed like you were barely even listening earlier.
lines.zh: : 是什么让你改主意了？刚刚你看起来根本没在听。

lines.en: : You just suck at explainin’ shit. Obviously I’m gonna be interested if weird, supernatural-ish shit starts happenin’ to me. I just ain’t sure if we can, like...do anything about it yet.
lines.zh: : 你只是太不会解释了。要是有什么奇怪的、近乎超自然的事发生在我身上，我当然会感兴趣。我只是不确定我们能不能……对此做点什么。

lines.en: : But if you’ve got ideas...I can, like...listen or whatever. Even if you’re just fuckin’ with me. Which you probably are. But at least it’s a little...entertaining, I guess.
lines.zh: : 但你要是有想法……我可以……听听什么的。就算你只是在耍我——你八成就是在耍我。不过至少……还挺有意思的吧。

lines.en: : You’re hungry, right?
lines.zh: : 你饿了吧？

lines.en: : Kind of. Was too busy makin’ sure you didn’t walk into oncoming traffic to stop and eat.
lines.zh: : 有点。我忙着确保你别走到车流里去，根本没空停下来吃东西。

lines.en: : Then how about we continue this conversation in the cafeteria?
lines.zh: : 那我们去食堂继续聊？

lines.en: scene black
Something feels different.
lines.zh: 有什么感觉不一样了。

lines.en: Dangerous, even.
lines.zh: 甚至有点危险。

lines.en: But the danger surprisingly does not lie in my own hands and their ability to effortlessly pluck the petals from premature flowers.
lines.zh: 但令人意外的是，危险并不在我自己的手上，也不在它们轻而易举摘下早开之花的花瓣的能力上。

lines.en: It lies in the air.
lines.zh: 它在空气里。

lines.en: I can feel it becoming tangible...twisting into the shape of hands.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到它变得可触……扭曲成手的形状。

lines.en: I can see their fingers elongating...tightly constricting our necks.
lines.zh: 我能看见它们的手指变长……紧紧勒住我们的脖子。

lines.en: All that’s left is to patiently wait and see which one of us chokes first.
lines.zh: 剩下的只有耐心等待，看我们谁先窒息。

lines.en: I hope it’s her.
lines.zh: 我希望是她。

lines.en: It would be easier to take her home if she were unconscious.
lines.zh: 她要是昏过去了，我带她回家更容易些。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool9
: This place always feels so different at night...
lines.zh: : 这地方在晚上总是感觉很不一样……

lines.en: : Takes a lot to creep me out but, not gonna lie, this shit comes close.
lines.zh: : 能让我发毛的事不多，不过说实话，这地方算一个。

lines.en: : It doesn’t take a lot to creep you out. I successfully creep you out every single day.
lines.zh: : 让你发毛可不需要多少功夫。我每天都成功让你发毛。

lines.en: : Yeah, the thought of getting raped will do that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，一想到会被强奸，谁都会这样。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool10
: I wouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 我不会——

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, shit gets even creepier when you turn the lights on.
lines.zh: : 奇怪的是，把灯打开之后反而更瘆人了。

lines.en: : Think it’s probably cause it feels less like sneakin’ in and more like everybody’s just...gone. Like the whole world’s in the process of vanishing or some shit.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为那样就不像偷偷溜进来了，而更像是所有人……都消失了。就像整个世界正在消失什么的。

lines.en: : Well, I can definitely relate to that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这我可太有同感了。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool11
: You come here often? At night, I mean.
lines.zh: : 你经常来这儿吗？我是说，晚上。

lines.en: : Are you hitting on me?
lines.zh: : 你这是在撩我？

lines.en: : No, but I will hit you if you say that again.
lines.zh: : 不是，但你要再这么说我就揍你。

lines.en: : Every once in a while, I’ll show up. I don’t think it’s ever really been intentional, though.
lines.zh: : 偶尔会来。不过我觉得从来都不是有意的。

lines.en: : You mean with your blackouts? They lead you here often?
lines.zh: : 你是说你断片的时候？它们经常把你带到这儿？

lines.en: : Either them or a small girl with a ponytail.
lines.zh: : 要么是它们，要么是一个扎马尾的小女孩。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool12
: Your niece’s friend? The fuck would she have to do here so late at night?
lines.zh: : 你侄女的朋友？她深更半夜在这儿能干什么？

lines.en: : Either she has a very strange hobby or it has something to do with why time is stuck-
lines.zh: : 要么她有个很奇怪的爱好，要么这跟时间为什么卡住了有关——

lines.en: scene yuminightschool13
: Wait. Hold that thought. Do you want food or some shit? Because I’ve gotta feeling this is gonna be a long ass explanation and I ain’t gonna be able to listen without something to eat.
lines.zh: : 等等。先打住。你要吃的什么的吗？因为我有种预感，这解释会长得要命，没点吃的我听不下去。

lines.en: : I’m-
: Fuck it. I’ll just pick something out for you. You’ve treated me to dinner during the job search BS, so I’ve got you this one time.
lines.zh: : 算了。我替你挑吧。找工作那阵子你请我吃过饭，这次我请回你一次。

lines.en: : Well, thank you for treating me to a meal that I do not want with money you do not have to use.
lines.zh: : 那好吧，谢谢你用你根本不必花的钱，请我吃了顿我根本不想吃的饭。

lines.en: : You should really say thank you when people do nice things for you, prick.
lines.zh: : 别人对你好，你真该说声谢谢，混蛋。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool14
Yumi disappears into the kitchen, but doesn’t take it upon herself to kill the darkness as the only light I can make out from here is the faint glow of a refrigerator door opening.
lines.zh: Yumi 钻进了厨房，却没顺手把黑暗赶走——我从这儿唯一能辨认的光，是冰箱门打开时透出的微弱亮光。

lines.en: I can tell from the way she moves that she really has done this before, but I’m not sure if I should be thankful I haven’t bumped into her here or...disappointed? Is that the right word?
lines.zh: 从她的动作能看出，她以前真干过这事，但我不确定自己该庆幸从没在这儿撞见过她，还是……失望？失望这个词对吗？

lines.en: If I had crossed paths with her while on one of several trips with Maya, maybe it wouldn’t have taken so long to reel Yumi into this segment of the hidden world?
lines.zh: 如果我在和 Maya 的某次出行中撞见过她，也许就不用花那么久才把 Yumi 拽进这个隐秘世界的这一块？

lines.en: After all, she does seem at least slightly central to some “deeper” aspect of my life given how frequently I lose my mind around her...
lines.zh: 毕竟，鉴于我在她身边失神的频率之高，她在我生命中某些「更深」的层面上，似乎至少也算个中心人物……

lines.en: But would that alone have been enough to convince her to hear me out?
lines.zh: 但光是这一点，就足以说服她听我说完吗？

lines.en: And will she hear anything at all when my half-baked attempts at explaining things add up to no more than just “your memory is broken but so is mine. Let’s have a sleepover?”
lines.zh: 当我那些半吊子的解释加在一起，充其量不过是「你的记忆坏了，我的也坏了。我们来睡衣派对吧」时，她又能听进去什么呢？

lines.en: I have no idea what I’m doing...nor any idea of what I even want Yumi’s role to be if things do continue to progress like this.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己在做什么……也不知道如果事情真这样发展下去，我到底想让 Yumi 扮演什么角色。

lines.en: All I know is I’d feel a little emptier if the one segment of common ground we’ve found ruptured and split.
lines.zh: 我只知道，如果我们好不容易找到的那一点共同之处破裂、分离，我会觉得更空虚一些。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool15
When she returns, I think about what I would have done if I never encountered Maya on the rooftop that night so long ago.
lines.zh: 她回来时，我在想，如果很久以前那个晚上我没有在天台上遇见 Maya，我会变成什么样。

lines.en: Would I have felt lonely?
lines.zh: 我会觉得孤独吗？

lines.en: Would I have maintained the steady pursuit of fucking my entire classroom — completely disregarding how empty it would have felt apart from the momentary warmth?
lines.zh: 我会不会还在持之以恒地追求睡遍全班——完全不去想，除了片刻的温存之外，那会是多么空洞？

lines.en: Where would it have ended?
lines.zh: 那会在哪里结束？

lines.en: I think for another moment about what would have become of the other me’s that never felt the first traces of waking up...but I have no reason to brag when I’ve only just begun to open my eyes.
lines.zh: 我又想了一会儿，那些从未感受到一丝苏醒迹象的「我」会变成什么样……但我才刚刚睁开眼，没什么好炫耀的。

lines.en: When will it end?
lines.zh: 什么时候才会结束？

lines.en: Just what is the point of all of this?
lines.zh: 这一切到底有什么意义？

lines.en: : Uhh...hello?
scene yuminightschool16
: Hi.
: Okay, good. Wasn’t sure if you were “there” again or not.
lines.zh: : 好，很好。我刚才不确定你是不是又「不在」了。

lines.en: : I am. And thanks again for the free food that I didn’t want.
lines.zh: : 我在。还有，再次谢谢那份我不想要的免费食物。

lines.en: : You sure? Cause you haven’t eaten all day either. Been with you the whole time.
lines.zh: : 你确定？因为你一整天也没吃东西。我一直跟你在一起。

lines.en: : Ami gets mad if I don’t eat the dinner she makes for me every night, so I’ll hold out if it means not getting an earful from her in the morning.
lines.zh: : Ami 每天晚上做的晚饭我要是不吃，她会生气。所以我就忍着吧，反正这样明早也不至于被她念叨。

lines.en: : Damn. She’s got you even more whipped than I thought.
lines.zh: : 操。她把你管得比我想的还死。

lines.en: : She involved in all this weird, time-related stuff too? Or is that reserved for just you and Ponytail?
lines.zh: : 她也卷进了这些和时间有关的怪事？还是说这只有你和马尾丫头知道？

lines.en: : Ami’s unrelated. It’s just Maya, Ayane, and me right now.
lines.zh: : Ami 无关。目前只有 Maya、Ayane 和我。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool17
: Huh. Guess that helps explain why the blonde one’s so fuckin’ obsessed with you and shit.
lines.zh: : 哈。这大概能解释那个金发妹为什么那么他妈迷恋你什么的。

lines.en: : She was like that before- actually, yes. That is why she loves me.
lines.zh: : 她以前就是那样——不，等等，对。她就是因为这才爱我的。

lines.en: : It’s hard not growing close to someone when you live through the apocalypse together.
lines.zh: : 一起经历过世界末日，很难不跟对方亲近起来。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool18
: Apocalypse? The fuck is this about an apocalypse? I thought we just had some disease or that time was, like...glitching out or some shit. Nobody said anything about an apocalypse.
lines.zh: : 世界末日？这他妈怎么又扯上世界末日了？我以为我们只是得了什么病，或者时间……出故障什么的。没人说过什么世界末日。

lines.en: : That’s just sort of how we started referring to it.
lines.zh: : 我们后来就这么叫它了。

lines.en: : You’ll get a more in-depth answer if you decide you really do want to look more into this, but the bare-bones explanation is that the world is going to end soon and only a few of us are going to remember it.
lines.zh: : 如果你真决定深入调查，会得到更详细的答案。但最简略的解释是：这个世界很快就要终结，而我们之中只有少数人会记得。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool19
: The fuck do you mean it’s going to end? How can you stay so calm while saying that shit?
lines.zh: : 你他妈说什么就要终结了？说出这种话你怎么还能这么冷静？

lines.en: : Because it’s going to start again right afterward. At the same place in the school year, but not the same place in time. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 因为它在那之后会立刻重新开始。在学年的同一个位置，但不是时间上的同一个位置。你明白吗？

lines.en: : No. Fuck no. Am I being Punk’d? Are there cameras here or some shit?
lines.zh: : 不明白。他妈的一点也不。我是不是被整蛊了？这儿有摄像头还是什么的？

lines.en: : I really hope not. My job would be in even greater jeopardy than it already is.
lines.zh: : 我真希望没有。那我的工作就比现在更岌岌可危了。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool20
: Apocalypse...a new world...reliving the same school year?
lines.zh: : 世界末日……一个新世界……重过同一个学年？

lines.en: : How...how the fuck am I supposed to believe that?
lines.zh: : 我……我他妈凭什么要相信这种事？

lines.en: : The only way to believe it is to see it for yourself, I think.
lines.zh: : 我想，要相信它，唯一的办法就是亲眼看见。

lines.en: : And if I...
lines.zh: : 那如果我……

lines.en: : If I sleep with you, I’ll somehow-
lines.zh: : 如果我跟你睡，我就能——

lines.en: : I’m going to stop you right there because that is definitely not what I was getting at when I suggested that you sleep over my house.
lines.zh: : 我得在这儿打断你一下，因为我提议你去我家过夜，绝对不是这个意思。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool21
: Be a little more honest about that next time! Of course I was gonna think that’s what you were tryin’ to get at! What kind of grown man just has a normal sleepover with teenage girls?!
lines.zh: : 下次你能不能说明白点！我当然会以为你想的就是那个！哪个成年男人会跟未成年少女开什么正经的睡衣派对？！

lines.en: : I’m not the leader of a sex cult, Yumi. I’m just some guy with advanced knowledge of how the world works who is trying to shepherd others into understanding as well.
lines.zh: : 我不是什么性爱邪教的头目，Yumi。我只是个对世界运作方式了解得多一点的人，想引导别人也弄明白。

lines.en: : That sounds exactly like what the leader of a sex cult would say!
lines.zh: : 这话听起来跟性爱邪教头目会说的一模一样！

lines.en: : You don’t have to sleep with me. You literally just have to show up and hang out at my place so we can all monitor each other and discuss what’s been going on.
lines.zh: : 你不用跟我睡。你只要人到我家，大家待在一起互相照应，聊聊最近发生的事就行。

lines.en: : Like I said, you’re one of the only people who has ever been able to grasp that things aren’t exactly as they seem. So we want to use you as a sort of...test subject, I guess.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，你是极少数能意识到事情并不像表面那样的人之一。所以我们想把你当成某种……实验对象之类的。

lines.en: : And that’s supposed to convince me?!
lines.zh: : 就这还想说服我？！

lines.en: : What would convince you? Because if honesty doesn’t work, I’m not really sure what else to do. I’m not going to force you.
lines.zh: : 那什么才能说服你？如果诚实不管用，我真不知道还能怎么办。我不会强迫你。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool22
: Hah...
: How the fuck would I explain that to Chika?
lines.zh: : 我他妈要怎么跟 Chika 解释？

lines.en: : I get that you ain’t just pervin’ out on me this time, but I’ve got no idea how to tell her that I’m stayin’ at your place even if I do decide to.
lines.zh: : 我知道你这次不只是想对我发情，但就算我决定去，我也不知道该怎么跟她说我要住你家。

lines.en: : Then don’t tell her.
lines.zh: : 那就别告诉她。

lines.en: : She’s my best friend and she’s...fuckin’ in love with you for whatever reason. I can’t just ignore that because it’s convenient.
lines.zh: : 她是我最好的朋友，而且她……不知道为什么他妈爱上了你。我不能因为方便就装作没这回事。

lines.en: : Convenience doesn’t have anything to do with it, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 这跟方便不方便没关系，Yumi。

lines.en: : I’m obviously not one to model your priorities after, but I don’t think it’s all that far-fetched to say getting to the bottom of a time loop is a little more important than love.
lines.zh: : 我显然不是你该拿来当榜样的人，但我觉得，说弄清时间循环的真相要比爱情重要一点，也不算太离谱。

lines.en: : Doubt Chika would agree.
lines.zh: : Chika 大概不会同意。

lines.en: : Chika probably won’t even remember once everything is said and done. But I guess I can’t guarantee that as it seems the memories that do carry over are very...inconsistent.
lines.zh: : 等一切尘埃落定，Chika 大概根本不会记得。不过我也没法保证，因为能留存下来的记忆似乎非常……不稳定。

lines.en: : Inconsistent how?
lines.zh: : 怎么个不稳定法？

lines.en: : Inconsistent like...some memories are just omitted if they have anything to do with time or...events surrounding the whole world-resetting ordeal.
lines.zh: : 不稳定就是……如果某些记忆和时间有关，或者和世界重置那档子事有关，它们就会被直接抹掉。

lines.en: : But memories like being sexually assaulted by a teacher get to stay? Sounds fair.
lines.zh: : 可被老师性侵这种记忆就能留下？真公平啊。

lines.en: scene yuminightschool23
: Figures the world would go out of its way to make my life even shittier. Ain’t like it’s done enough of that already.
lines.zh: : 果然，这个世界就是非要让我的人生更烂一点。好像它之前做得还不够似的。

lines.en: : Whether it be deadbeat parents...or growin’ up too mean to get anybody to like me...or havin’ a teacher who openly admits to beating off to his students...
lines.zh: : 不管是废柴父母……还是长成一个没人喜欢的刻薄鬼……还是有个公开承认对着学生打飞机的老师……

lines.en: : Or how I...how despite that, I...
lines.zh: : 还是说，尽管如此，我……

lines.en: scene yuminightschool24
: I get it.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : You don’t have to come.
lines.zh: : 你不一定要来。

lines.en: : I’ll tell Maya and Ayane that-
lines.zh: : 我会告诉 Maya 和 Ayane——

lines.en: : I’ll...do it.
scene yuminightschool25
: I’ll do it, but...I still ain’t sure what I’m gonna say to Chika. And if you do anything to make me feel even slightly uncomfortable while I’m there, I’m noping the fuck out. Got it?
lines.zh: : 我会去，但……我还是不知道该怎么跟 Chika 说。还有，只要你在那儿让我有一丁点不舒服，我就他妈立刻走人。明白吗？

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: That’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没问题。

lines.en: : Cool.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : Anyway, I ain’t really hungry anymore, so...I’m gonna, like...get rid of all this shit so nobody knows anyone was here when they weren’t supposed to be.
lines.zh: : 总之，我不怎么饿了，所以……我打算……把这些东西都收拾掉，免得有人知道在不该出现的时候有人来过。

lines.en: : I’ll be fucked out of a bunch of meals in the future if security suddenly tightens and...yeah. I’ll clear your tray too, I guess.
lines.zh: : 要是安保突然变严，我以后就少了很多顿饭……是啊。你的餐盘我也一起收了吧。

lines.en: : Yumi-
lines.zh: : Yumi——

lines.en: : How about we just...shut the fuck up for a little while, okay?
lines.zh: : 我们要不就……先他妈闭一会儿嘴，行吗？

lines.en: scene black
Yumi clears everything off of the table and, for the next ten minutes, we keep our lips sealed.
lines.zh: Yumi 把桌上的东西全收拾干净，接下来的十分钟，我们谁也没开口。

lines.en: scene thisisgreen5
scene yuminightschool26
But something we find in the hallway beckons us to part them.
lines.zh: 可我们在走廊里发现的东西，又让我们不得不张开了嘴。

lines.en: : What the...fuck?
lines.zh: : 这他妈……什么鬼？

lines.en: : That...wasn’t there the whole time, was it? Didn’t we come down this hallway on the way to the cafeteria?
lines.zh: : 那东西……不是一直都在那儿的吧？我们去食堂的路上不是走过这条走廊吗？

lines.en: scene thisisgreen5
scene yuminightschool27
: We did...
lines.zh: : 我们走过……

lines.en: : Are we...not alone in here?
lines.zh: : 我们……在这儿不是一个人？

lines.en: : Somebody’s gotta be playin’ a prank on us, right?
lines.zh: : 肯定有人在捉弄我们吧？

lines.en: : You said Ponytail or...uhh...Maya or whatever comes here too, right? Would she do something like this?
lines.zh: : 你说马尾丫头或者……呃……Maya 什么的也来这儿，对吧？她会干这种事吗？

lines.en: : Cause this ain’t-
lines.zh: : 因为这可不——

lines.en: scene yuminightschool28
: Yo! What are you doing?! There could be, like...a bomb in there or some shit!
lines.zh: : 喂！你干什么？！里面搞不好有……炸弹什么的！

lines.en: : I have to move it.
lines.zh: : 我得把它搬开。

lines.en: : If I don’t move it, we can’t leave.
lines.zh: : 不搬开我们就出不去。

lines.en: : We can just walk around it, you fucking idiot! It ain’t like it’s-
lines.zh: : 我们绕过去就行了，你这白痴！又不是说——

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
: Lucy, I’m hooooooome!
lines.zh: : Lucy，我回——家——啦！

lines.en: : And I brought a PRIIIIIIIIIIZE!
lines.zh: : 我还带了份——大——奖！

lines.en: scene black
THE DAY ENDS
lines.zh: 这一天结束了

lines.en: $ yumislumber3 = True
$ yumi_love += 3
A NEW ONE BEGINS
lines.zh: 新的一天开始了

lines.en: And I know what it is I have to do.
lines.zh: 而我知道自己该做什么了。

lines.en: jump slumberphonemenu
